articles.title: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
articles.snippet: Circle sold 1.24 million shares at $80.84 each and will pay Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC held through its wallet infrastructure.

articles.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
articles.snippet: Inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs picked up Monday as bitcoin rallied to its highest since January.

articles.title: Binance takes $100M stake in Circle under expanded USDC deal
articles.snippet: Circle sold Binance $100 million in stock and agreed to pay monthly incentives under an expanded five-year partnership promoting USDC.

articles.title: ECB to put its own money into tokenized securities via new Pontes DLT
articles.snippet: The ECB aims to gain firsthand DLT market experience by buying tokenized public-sector securities and settling the trades through Pontes.

articles.title: Crypto metric signals altseason as Bitcoin market-cap share stalls below 60%
articles.snippet: Glassnode’s Altcoin Cycle Signal printed a new altseason signal after a month of Bitcoin and altcoin market-cap gains.
